app.name: Sport Club Organizer
app.tagline: Plan seasons, teams, trainers and gyms — and generate a training schedule your club can rely on.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to manage your club.
auth.inviteOnly: Clubs are invitation-only. Ask an administrator for an invite.
auth.resetSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetLinkSentBody: If an account exists for that address, a password reset link is on its way. The link expires in one hour.
auth.newPasswordSubtitle: You'll be signed in once it's saved.
auth.signInFailedBody: We couldn't complete sign-in. Please try again.
auth.errorMissingCode: The sign-in link was incomplete. Please start again.
auth.errorExchangeFailed: That sign-in link has already been used or has expired.

invitation.signInAs: Sign in as {email} to join as {role}.
invitation.wrongAccountTitle: This invitation is for someone else
invitation.wrongAccountBody: It was sent to {invited}, but you're signed in as {current}. Sign out and sign back in with the invited address.
invitation.expiredBody: Ask a club administrator to send you a new one.
invitation.usedTitle: This invitation has already been used
invitation.usedBody: If it was you, just sign in. Otherwise ask for a new invitation.
invitation.revokedBody: A club administrator revoked it. Get in touch with them if that's unexpected.
invitation.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete. Copy it from your email again, in full.

noAccess.title: You're not in a club yet
noAccess.body: You're signed in as {email}, but you don't belong to any club. Clubs are invitation-only — ask an administrator to invite this address, then open the link in the invitation email.

selectClub.title: Choose a club
selectClub.subtitle: You belong to more than one club. Pick one to continue.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.setupBody: Seasons hold your teams, availability and schedules. Create one to get started.
dashboard.askOrganizer: Ask a club organizer to create the first season.

admin.title: System console
admin.systemAccessBody: You can read and administer every club here without being a member of any of them. Entering a club is written to that club's audit log, and the app shows a banner while you're inside one.
admin.noClubsBody: Create the first club to get started. You'll pick an Owner for it.
admin.createSubtitle: A club is a tenant — one organisation, with its own teams, athletes, gyms and schedules, isolated from every other.
admin.ownerEmailHint: Defaults to you. If this address has no account yet, one is created and you'll get an invitation link to pass on.
admin.timezoneHint: Recurring availability is interpreted in this timezone.
admin.invitedTitle: Club created — send the owner their link
admin.invitedBody: {email} had no account, so one was created and they were made Owner. Email delivery isn't wired up yet, so pass this link on yourself. It sets their password and expires.
admin.singleUseBody: This link signs them in once to choose a password. It won't be shown again — if it's lost, they can use “Forgot password” instead.

staffBanner.message: You're viewing {club} as a platform administrator. You aren't a member of this club, and this visit is in its audit log.

errors.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: You need to sign in to continue.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_ERROR: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.CONFLICT: That conflicts with something that already exists.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTEGRATION_ERROR: An integration failed. Please try again.
errors.EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR: An external service is unavailable. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again.
errors.pageBody: We couldn't load this page. Try again — if it keeps happening, let your club administrator know.
errors.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

list.noResultsBody: Nothing matched your search. Try a different term or clear the filters.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.subtitle: A season holds the teams, availability and schedules for one year.
seasons.name: Name
seasons.emptyBody: Create a season to start adding teams, availability and schedules.
seasons.onlyOneActive: Making this season active will archive the current active season.
seasons.duplicateBody: Copies teams, trainer and gym assignments, availability and training requirements into a new season. Schedules and past events are never copied.
seasons.archiveConfirmBody: Its teams and schedules are preserved and stay readable. You can't add new training to an archived season.

gyms.title: Gyms
gyms.subtitle: Where your teams train.
gyms.name: Name
gyms.sportTypesHint: Which sports this hall can host. Used to narrow candidate gyms when scheduling.
gyms.emptyBody: Add the halls your club trains in. The scheduler needs at least one.
gyms.archiveConfirmBody: Past training sessions that used it are preserved. It won't be offered for new schedules.

trainers.title: Trainers
trainers.subtitle: Coaching staff and their availability.
trainers.emptyBody: Add your coaching staff. Each can then set the hours they're available.
trainers.archiveConfirmBody: Their past sessions are preserved. They won't be assigned to new training.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Squads for the selected season.
teams.name: Name
teams.emptyBody: Add the squads training this season.
teams.emptyNoSeasonBody: Teams belong to a season, so there needs to be one before you can add them.
teams.archiveConfirmBody: Its history and past schedules are preserved.

athletes.title: Athletes
athletes.subtitle: Everyone who trains at the club.
athletes.emptyBody: Add the people who train at your club, then assign them to teams.
athletes.archiveConfirmBody: Their team history is preserved. They won't appear in new squads.
